title: FRUIT
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
Today we are learning all about special type of 
Jesus fruit
FRUIT of the SPIRIT

There are 9 
LOVE, JOY, PEACE
PATIENCE, KINDNESS, GOODNESS,
FAITHFULLNESS, GENTLENESS and SELF CONTROL
We are gong to try and learn them by singing this song
Ask your mom or dad to print out and you can cut out the fruit and glue them on to the tree
